title: NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl
abstract:
Welcome to GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)! This is a unified platform for developing and deploying advanced humanoid controllers. This includes: Decoupled WBC models used in NVIDIA Isaac-Gr00t, Gr00t N1.5 and N1.6 and GEAR-SONIC

[ ](LICENSE) [ ](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/releases/tag/v2.3.2) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/demo.html) --- # GR00T-WholeBodyControl This is the codebase for the **GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)** projects. It hosts model checkpoints and scripts for training, evaluating, and deploying advanced whole-body controllers for humanoid robots. We currently support: - **Decoupled WBC**: the decoupled controller (RL for lower body, and IK for upper body) used in NVIDIA GR00T [N1.5](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_5/) and [N1.6](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_6/) models; - **GEAR-SONIC Series**: our latest iteration of generalist humanoid whole-body controllers (see our [whitepaper](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/)); - **MotionBricks**: a real-time latent generative model for interactive motion control in animation and robotics (see the [project page](https://nvlabs.github.io/motionbricks/)). ## News - **[2026-09-14]** **IsaacTeleop 1.4 and AGX Orin support**: Added IsaacTeleop 1.4 and Jetson AGX Orin support for PICO teleoperation. - **[2026-08-31]** **SONIC deployment update** — added per-motor Kp/Kd scaling to reduce stumbling. - **[2026-07-23]** **SONIC v1.1 checkpoint** — released a robot-heading-normalized SONIC controller trained with wrist-pose augmentation for whole-body teleoperation and SONIC-backed VLA execution. See the [Model Card](#model-card) and [Download Models](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/getting_started/download_models.html#sonic-v11-checkpoint). - **[2026-06-16]** **Isaac Teleop Setup (CloudXR / DeviceIO, in-process)** — added bring-up docs for the in-process CloudXR path via `isaacteleop[cloudxr]`, with no separate publisher container. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：构建 GR00T-WholeBodyControl 统一平台，托管模型 checkpoint 与训练/评估/部署脚本，核心包含三类控制器：解耦式 WBC（下肢用 RL、上肢用 IK，服务于 GR00T N1.5/N1.6）、GEAR-SONIC 通用人形全身控制器系列，以及面向动画与机器人交互式运动控制的实时潜变量生成模型 MotionBricks。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人全身控制（WBC）此前缺乏统一的训练、评估与部署平台，且上下肢控制目标差异大、真机部署易受硬件与遥操作链路限制。该工作把 NVIDIA GR00T 系列所用的控制器集中到一个代码库中开放，降低复现与落地门槛。


# 二、方法

> 构建 GR00T-WholeBodyControl 统一平台，托管模型 checkpoint 与训练/评估/部署脚本，核心包含三类控制器：解耦式 WBC（下肢用 RL、上肢用 IK，服务于 GR00T N1.5/N1.6）、GEAR-SONIC 通用人形全身控制器系列，以及面向动画与机器人交互式运动控制的实时潜变量生成模型 MotionBricks。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) 发布 SONIC v1.1 checkpoint（2026-07-23），采用机器人朝向归一化并用腕部姿态增强训练，支持全身遥操作与 SONIC 驱动的 VLA 执行；2) SONIC 部署新增逐电机 Kp/Kd 缩放（2026-08-31）以显著减少行走磕绊/失稳；3) 新增 IsaacTeleop 1.4 与 Jetson AGX Orin 支持用于 PICO 遥操作（2026-09-14），并补充 in-process CloudXR / DeviceIO 低延迟遥操作链路（2026-06-16）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与具身智能/人形控制课题高度相关：价值在于工程化统一的训练—部署闭环与遥操作集成，但仓库公告以版本更新为主，缺少量化基准对比；解耦式 RL+IK 路线在强动态全身任务上的上限，以及 MotionBricks 生成式控制在真机上的实时性与安全性，仍是值得关注的开放问题。
